description: This Java class 'DefaultStreamConfig' provides the default implementation of the 'StreamConfig' interface. It handles configuration settings related to streaming, such as maximum array size, write interval, ask timeout, and nested configurations for retrieval, persistence, and cache. The class includes methods to create instances based on a provided configuration, and overrides for 'equals', 'hashCode', and 'toString'.

classes.name: DefaultStreamConfig
